title: Make Bahia relay policy durable and upgrade-safe
scope: Backend PostgreSQL projection, multi-relay hydration, signer-first ContextVM projection read model, and deterministic regression tests. UI and backup/upgrade workflows are excluded.
intended_behavior: Only a fully validated trusted service-signed canonical relay policy can replace the PostgreSQL last-known-good projection.
All eligible configured relays participate in hydration; EOSE is tracked per relay and followed by a bounded drain.
Absence and transport or parsing failures retain the prior projection; empty policy requires an explicit signed event.
Signer-first ContextVM reads expose canonical policy separately from server projection provenance and freshness.
security: No secret-bearing signer URLs, keys, relay credentials, or administrator credentials are emitted by this feature.
